notes: Run each case in an isolated sandbox whose PATH puts fake claude, pi and opencode CLIs first (tests/fixtures/fake_*.py); cases 2-4 remove one or more workers from the sandbox. No worker model is called.

evals.name: list-available-workers
evals.prompt: Which coding agents can I use with codex-crew on this machine?
evals.expected_output: A per-worker report from relay.py workers, with the default, and unchecked sign-in not presented as confirmed.
assertions: relay.py workers was run (visible in transcript)
No relay run record exists (no paid live check without asking)
The final answer names claude, pi and opencode with a ready/not-ready status for each
The final answer names claude as the default
The final answer does not describe OpenCode's sign-in as confirmed

evals.name: missing-opencode-install-advice
evals.prompt: I want to use OpenCode with codex-crew. Is it set up?
evals.expected_output: The agent finds OpenCode missing and asks before installing it, giving the install command without running it.
assertions: relay.py workers or preflight --worker opencode was run
The final answer says OpenCode is not installed / not found
The final answer includes an OpenCode install command
No npm install command was executed (transcript)

evals.name: pi-missing-opencode-available-choice
evals.prompt: Set up a codex-crew worker for me. I prefer Pi, but tell me my options before you install anything.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports Pi missing and OpenCode available, then asks whether to install Pi or use OpenCode. It installs nothing until the user chooses.
assertions: relay.py workers was run (visible in transcript)
The final answer reports Pi as missing and OpenCode as ready/available
The final answer offers installing Pi or using OpenCode and asks the user to choose
No npm install command was executed (transcript)
No relay run record exists (no live worker call)

evals.name: both-missing-asks-worker-choice
evals.prompt: Help me set up codex-crew; I haven't chosen between Pi and OpenCode.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports both missing, recommends Pi, and asks which CLI to install before running npm.
assertions: relay.py workers was run (visible in transcript)
The final answer reports both Pi and OpenCode as missing
The final answer recommends Pi and asks which worker to install
No npm install command was executed (transcript)
No relay run record exists (no live worker call)

evals.name: both-ready-prefers-pi
evals.prompt: Set up my codex-crew worker. I have no preference.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks worker readiness and selects Pi by default without starting a live run.
assertions: relay.py workers was run (visible in transcript)
The final answer selects or recommends Pi as the preferred worker
The final answer does not start a live worker run
